estimates.assumptions: 1 medium carrot is approximately 61g edible portion (standard weight for a 6-7 inch peeled carrot).
3 chopped scallions (green onions) total ~45g edible portion (about 15g per medium scallion).
3 cups shredded cabbage weighs ~210g (standard density ~70g per cup for shredded raw cabbage).
1 tablespoon rice vinegar is ~15g by volume; caloriesPer100g left null as known value is null and vinegar is very low calorie (~20 kcal/100g typically).
Modest brushing/spraying oil for a batch of 12 egg rolls estimated at 10g total (light application, not deep fry).
'To serve' is not a quantified recipe ingredient amount; grams left null as no reasonable estimate possible without assuming unstated serving size.
